<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden creature</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:244px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
canvas{display:block;width:244px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const W=244,H=240;
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W,H);
renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-122,122,120,-120,1,1800);
ref.position.set(0,120,760);
ref.lookAt(0,120,0);
const V=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const P=(x,y,z)=>V(x-122,240-y,z);
const mix=THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const clamp=THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
function smooth(a,b,x){
  const t=clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);
  return t*t*(3-2*t);
}
function group(parent,name,position){
  const g=new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  if(position) g.position.copy(position);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function ramp(entries){
  const stops=entries.map(([x,c])=>[x,new THREE.Color(c)]);
  return x=>{
    let i=0;
    while(i<stops.length-2 && x>stops[i+1][0]) i++;
    const [a,c]=stops[i],[b,d]=stops[i+1];
    return c.clone().lerp(d,clamp((x-a)/(b-a),0,1));
  };
}
function tangent(a,b){
  return a*b<=0?0:2*a*b/(a+b);
}
function hermite(a,b,da,db,h,t){
  const t2=t*t,t3=t2*t;
  return (2*t3-3*t2+1)*a+(t3-2*t2+t)*h*da
    +(-2*t3+3*t2)*b+(t3-t2)*h*db;
}
function profile(rows){
  const last=rows.length-1;
  const slopes=rows.map((r,i)=>r.slice(1).map((v,k)=>{
    const l=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)],n=rows[Math.min(last,i+1)];
    const a=i?(v-l[k+1])/(r[0]-l[0]):0;
    const b=i<last?(n[k+1]-v)/(n[0]-r[0]):0;
    return i===0?b:i===last?a:tangent(a,b);
  }));
  return x=>{
    let i=0;
    while(i<last-1 && x>rows[i+1][0]) i++;
    const a=rows[i],b=rows[i+1],h=b[0]-a[0];
    const t=clamp((x-a[0])/h,0,1);
    return a.slice(1).map((v,k)=>hermite(v,b[k+1],slopes[i][k],slopes[i+1][k],h,t));
  };
}
function oval(parent,name,position,scale,material){
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,28),material);
  mesh.name=name;
  mesh.position.copy(position);
  mesh.scale.copy(scale);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const sky=ramp([[0,0xffffff],[201,0xffffff],[209,0xfffcfc],[216,0xf6eff7],
  [222,0xe5e0ec],[228,0xcecdd5],[239,0xafb0aa]]);
const pixels=new Uint8Array(64*4);
for(let j=0;j<64;j++){
  const c=sky((63-j)*239/63).convertLinearToSRGB();
  pixels.set([Math.round(255*c.r),Math.round(255*c.g),Math.round(255*c.b),255],4*j);
}
const backdrop=new THREE.DataTexture(pixels,1,64);
backdrop.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
backdrop.magFilter=backdrop.minFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;
backdrop.needsUpdate=true;
scene.background=backdrop;

const creature=group(scene,'golden-creature');
const torso=group(creature,'torso');
const fur=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.94});
const bodyMaterial=fur.clone();
const pawShadows=[new THREE.Vector4(),new THREE.Vector4()];
bodyMaterial.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
  shader.uniforms.pawShadowL={value:pawShadows[0]};
  shader.uniforms.pawShadowR={value:pawShadows[1]};
  shader.vertexShader='varying vec3 coatPosition;\n'+shader.vertexShader;
  shader.vertexShader=shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <project_vertex>',
    '#include <project_vertex>\ncoatPosition=(modelMatrix*vec4(transformed,1.0)).xyz;');
  shader.fragmentShader=`
    varying vec3 coatPosition;
    uniform vec4 pawShadowL;
    uniform vec4 pawShadowR;
    float pawShade(vec4 p){
      vec2 v=(coatPosition.xy-p.xy)/p.zw;
      return exp(-dot(v,v)*1.42);
    }
  `+shader.fragmentShader;
  shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <color_fragment>',`
    #include <color_fragment>
    float shade=max(pawShade(pawShadowL),pawShade(pawShadowR))
               *smoothstep(-6.0,33.0,coatPosition.z);
    diffuseColor.rgb*=mix(vec3(1.0),vec3(.66,.48,.35),shade);
  `);
};

const bodyRows=[
  [-6,126,0,0,0],[-5.4,126,9.5,0,8.5],[-3.3,125.8,18.1,0,16.2],
  [0,125.5,24.3,0,22.5],[8,125.3,29.3,.7,28.2],
  [19,124.9,32.3,1.6,31.3],[31,124.8,34,2.2,33.5],
  [42,125,35.7,2.3,34.3],[52,125.2,38.4,1,33.4],
  [62,125.8,43.8,0,35.2],[75,126,53.4,-.4,41.8],
  [90,126,63.7,-.5,49.4],[109,126,71.3,-.8,55.7],
  [135,125.8,79.1,-1,62.5],[158,125.6,85.1,-1.2,68.4],
  [184,125,89.4,-1.4,72.8],[202,125.2,90.1,-1.3,73.6],
  [217,125.4,88.5,-1.1,72.4],[238,126.4,80.5,-1.5,67],
  [252,126.8,70.8,-2.2,59.6],[264,127,55,-3.1,47.7],
  [272,127,33,-3.8,29],[275,127,15,-4,13],[276,127,0,-4,0]
];
const bodyAt=profile(bodyRows);
const coat=ramp([[-6,0xffe539],[4,0xffdb29],[25,0xf8c82b],[43,0xe7a026],
  [57,0xe6991e],[73,0xf9bc22],[89,0xffc82b],[108,0xf7b739],
  [142,0xeaa236],[181,0xe5a03c],[209,0xe4a03b],[227,0xcf9738],
  [251,0xb58e36],[276,0xac8234]]);
const belly=ramp([[85,0xffcf66],[101,0xffdc99],[126,0xfbd4a6],
  [153,0xf0c497],[184,0xedb888],[203,0xeab07e],[215,0xe4a365],
  [233,0xd5a054],[264,0xc39748]]);
const socket=new THREE.Color(0x776c23),muzzle=new THREE.Color(0xf7b047);
const chin=new THREE.Color(0xd99332);
function bodyPaint(x,y,s,f){
  const c=coat(y);
  const bib=smooth(88+13*s*s+2*s,105+14*s*s+2*s,y)*smooth(-.06,.72,f);
  c.lerp(belly(y),.98*bib);
  if(f>0 && y<75){
    const spot=(cx,cy,rx,ry)=>Math.exp(-(((x-cx)/rx)**2+((y-cy)/ry)**2));
    c.lerp(muzzle,.62*spot(121,39,21,12));
    c.lerp(chin,.34*spot(122,53,25,12));
    c.lerp(socket,.85*smooth(.18,.5,f)*spot(102.6,26,6.4,7.55));
    c.lerp(socket,.85*smooth(.18,.5,f)*spot(145.1,21.8,6.4,7.55));
  }
  return c.multiplyScalar(.994+.006*Math.cos(4.5*s+y*.064)*Math.cos(y*.14-s*5));
}
function ringIndices(count,around){
  const out=[];
  for(let i=0;i<count-1;i++) for(let j=0;j<around;j++){
    const a=i*around+j,b=i*around+(j+1)%around;
    out.push(a,a+around,b,b,a+around,b+around);
  }
  return out;
}

const bodyGeometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
{
  const ys=[bodyRows[0][0]],around=112;
  for(let i=1;i<bodyRows.length;i++){
    const a=bodyRows[i-1][0],b=bodyRows[i][0],n=Math.ceil((b-a)/1.5);
    for(let j=1;j<=n;j++) ys.push(mix(a,b,j/n));
  }
  const pos=[],col=[],weights=[],indices=[];
  for(const y of ys){
    const [cx,rx,cz,rz]=bodyAt(y);
    const wh=1-smooth(43,100,y),wc=(1-wh)*(1-smooth(145,244,y));
    for(let j=0;j<around;j++){
      const a=2*Math.PI*j/around,s=Math.sin(a),f=Math.cos(a);
      const x=cx+rx*s,c=bodyPaint(x,y,s,f);
      pos.push(x-122,240-y,cz+rz*f);
      col.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      weights.push(Math.max(0,1-wc-wh),wc,wh,0);
      indices.push(0,1,2,0);
    }
  }
  bodyGeometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  bodyGeometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  bodyGeometry.setAttribute('skinWeight',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(weights,4));
  bodyGeometry.setAttribute('skinIndex',new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(indices,4));
  bodyGeometry.setIndex(ringIndices(ys.length,around));
  bodyGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const n=bodyGeometry.attributes.normal;
  for(let j=0;j<around;j++){
    n.setXYZ(j,0,1,0);
    n.setXYZ((ys.length-1)*around+j,0,-1,0);
  }
}

const body=new THREE.SkinnedMesh(bodyGeometry,bodyMaterial);
body.name='continuous-body-and-head';
torso.add(body);
const baseBone=new THREE.Bone(),chestBone=new THREE.Bone(),headBone=new THREE.Bone();
baseBone.name='body-base';
chestBone.name='chest-joint';
headBone.name='head-joint';
body.add(baseBone);
const chestPivot=P(125,126,0),headPivot=P(124,24,28);
const chest=group(baseBone,'chest',chestPivot);
const head=group(baseBone,'head',headPivot);
chest.add(chestBone);
head.add(headBone);
creature.updateMatrixWorld(true);
body.bind(new THREE.Skeleton([baseBone,chestBone,headBone]));

function faceDepth(x,y){
  const [cx,rx,cz,rz]=bodyAt(y);
  return cz+rz*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-((x-cx)/rx)**2));
}
function faceNormal(x,y){
  const e=.15;
  return V((faceDepth(x-e,y)-faceDepth(x+e,y))/(2*e),
    (faceDepth(x,y+e)-faceDepth(x,y-e))/(2*e),1).normalize();
}
const eyes=group(head,'eyes');
const eyeMaterial=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.67});
function makeEye(name,x,y,width,height){
  const eye=group(eyes,name,P(x,y,faceDepth(x,y)).sub(headPivot));
  eye.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,0,1),faceNormal(x,y));
  const geo=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,32),p=geo.attributes.position,colors=[];
  const black=new THREE.Color(0x171807),rim=new THREE.Color(0x655724);
  const shine=new THREE.Color(0x928a5f);
  for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
    const a=p.getX(i),b=p.getY(i),d=p.getZ(i);
    const c=black.clone().lerp(rim,(1-smooth(.03,.75,d))*.86);
    c.lerp(shine,.30*Math.exp(-(((a+.22)/.23)**2+((b-.35)/.2)**2))*Math.max(0,d));
    colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
  }
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  const bead=new THREE.Mesh(geo,eyeMaterial);
  bead.name='dark-eye';
  bead.scale.set(width,height,2.65);
  bead.position.z=-.15;
  eye.add(bead);
}
makeEye('left-eye',102.6,26,4.7,5.65);
makeEye('right-eye',145.1,21.8,4.65,5.75);

const mouth=group(head,'mouth',P(120.5,39,faceDepth(120.5,39)).sub(headPivot));
mouth.rotation.z=.055;
const lipGeometry=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,48,28);
const lp=lipGeometry.attributes.position,lipColors=[];
const lipRamp=ramp([[-1,0xc3862a],[-.38,0xd7962a],[-.19,0xdc9c31],
  [.10,0xf5b43b],[.72,0xf9c34a],[1,0xf2bb43]]);
for(let i=0;i<lp.count;i++){
  const x=lp.getX(i),y=lp.getY(i),z=lp.getZ(i),c=lipRamp(y);
  lipColors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
  lp.setXYZ(i,x*8.9,y*2.8+.75*x*x,z*3.35-.8*x*x);
}
lipGeometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(lipColors,3));
lipGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
const lips=new THREE.Mesh(lipGeometry,fur);
lips.name='little-closed-muzzle';
mouth.add(lips);

const times=[0,160,340,500,680,840,1020,1180];
function loopTrack(values){
  const count=times.length;
  const intervals=times.map((t,i)=>(i+1<count?times[i+1]:1200)-t);
  const slopes=values.map((row,i)=>{
    const a=(i+count-1)%count,b=(i+1)%count;
    return row.map((v,k)=>tangent((v-values[a][k])/intervals[a],
                                  (values[b][k]-v)/intervals[i]));
  });
  return (i,ms)=>{
    const next=(i+1)%count,h=intervals[i],t=(ms-times[i])/h;
    return values[i].map((v,k)=>hermite(v,values[next][k],slopes[i][k],slopes[next][k],h,t));
  };
}

// Face center displacement, head roll, shoulder swing, and chest displacement.
const bodyTrack=loopTrack([
  [0,0,0,0,0],[1.35,.95,-.181,1,-.8],
  [1.1,4.1,-.013,.14,.7],[.85,10.8,-.126,.80,-.55],
  [1.1,6.8,-.143,.90,-.45],[.15,1.55,-.014,.07,.25],
  [.9,5.55,-.161,.96,-.8],[1.5,10.2,-.065,.32,.5]
]);

// Each raised paw has four landmarks from its fingertip to its elbow,
// followed by its wrist radius, forearm radius, and turn toward the camera.
const leftTrack=loopTrack([
  [65,71.8,70.7,102,62.6,130,61.1,165.3,16.7,23.3,1],
  [17,54.7,18.7,95.0,24.3,113.7,25.2,138.5,12.0,18.1,.04],
  [55.1,86.2,58.8,122.6,56.7,148.4,57.0,174.6,17.4,20.6,.84],
  [20.7,91.7,26.6,131.4,29.8,149.0,29.2,169.6,13.5,17.7,.22],
  [20.3,87.2,24.2,122.8,32.1,142.7,32.1,163.8,12.3,16.7,.13],
  [59.0,76.2,63.5,109.7,56.2,135.9,54.8,166.8,17.8,21.7,.94],
  [18.1,72.6,20.6,112.6,26.2,131.8,26.8,153.8,12.6,18.0,.09],
  [43.8,97.7,48.6,134.7,49.4,155.5,51.0,181.3,17.2,19.7,.69]
]);
const rightTrack=loopTrack([
  [214.1,60,211.0,94.9,212.3,125.5,209.4,152.1,13.35,18.6,0],
  [152.7,76.9,157.4,115.4,183.2,136.2,182.4,169.4,17.9,25.0,1],
  [212.2,72.8,208.3,109.4,211.0,139.7,209.0,163.6,13.9,18.7,.12],
  [189.3,101.6,185.1,141.2,194.1,157.5,190.5,186.5,17.6,23.2,.77],
  [174.4,86.7,175.3,127.1,190.8,145.6,188.5,176.0,17.5,24.1,.91],
  [213.5,73.0,210.2,109.6,211.6,134.7,209.7,159.8,13.5,18.0,.06],
  [168.8,92.0,172.1,131.4,188.4,150.0,185.5,178.2,18.9,24.8,.97],
  [208.3,91.0,204.8,128.1,210.3,152.0,207.7,179.3,15.5,20.6,.31]
]);

const armGold=ramp([[0,0xf6c13c],[.85,0xfbbd39],[1.55,0xf1ae32],
  [2.25,0xeaa033],[2.78,0xd99633],[3,0xd79939]]);
const fingerGold=ramp([[0,0x977341],[.22,0x81582d],[.57,0x70491e],
  [.88,0x694016],[1.3,0x80501c]]);
const darkPad=new THREE.Color(0x4e3214);
const around=72;
const sines=[],cosines=[];
for(let j=0;j<around;j++){
  sines.push(Math.sin(j*2*Math.PI/around));
  cosines.push(Math.cos(j*2*Math.PI/around));
}
function sectionMesh(parent,name,lo,hi,count){
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry(),length=(count+1)*around*3;
  for(const key of ['position','normal','color']){
    geo.setAttribute(key,new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(length),3)
      .setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage));
  }
  geo.setIndex(ringIndices(count+1,around));
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,fur);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return {geo,lo,hi,count};
}

function updateSection(section,shape,origin,q,side){
  const {geo,lo,hi,count}=section;
  const pos=geo.attributes.position,norm=geo.attributes.normal,col=geo.attributes.color;
  const [ox,oy,oz]=origin,wx=q[2],wy=q[3],near=q[10];
  const edgeSlope=-side*mix(.32,.45,near);
  let k=0;
  for(let i=0;i<=count;i++){
    const u=mix(lo,hi,i/count);
    const [cx,y,cz,rx,rz]=shape(u);
    const a=shape(Math.max(0,u-.002)),b=shape(Math.min(3,u+.002));
    const dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],dz=b[2]-a[2],dr=b[3]-a[3],dd=b[4]-a[4];
    const gold=armGold(u),brown=fingerGold(u);
    for(let j=0;j<around;j++,k++){
      const s=sines[j],f=cosines[j],x=cx+rx*s;
      pos.setXYZ(k,x-ox,oy-y,cz+rz*f-oz);
      if(u===0 || u===3){
        norm.setXYZ(k,0,u===0?1:-1,0);
      }else{
        const nx=dy*rz*s,ny=(dz+dd*f)*rx*f+(dx+dr*s)*rz*s,nz=dy*rx*f;
        const n=Math.hypot(nx,ny,nz)||1;
        norm.setXYZ(k,nx/n,ny/n,nz/n);
      }
      const cap=1-smooth(-3.75,3.75,y-wy-(x-wx)*edgeSlope);
      const shade=.53*(.5-.5*side*s)*smooth(-.4,.9,f);
      const inward=1-.115*smooth(.38,1,-side*s)*smooth(.68,1.18,u);
      col.setXYZ(k,mix(gold.r,mix(brown.r,darkPad.r,shade),cap)*inward,
        mix(gold.g,mix(brown.g,darkPad.g,shade),cap)*inward,
        mix(gold.b,mix(brown.b,darkPad.b,shade),cap)*inward);
    }
  }
  pos.needsUpdate=norm.needsUpdate=col.needsUpdate=true;
  geo.computeBoundingBox();
  geo.computeBoundingSphere();
}

function makeArm(left){
  const side=left?-1:1;
  const arm=group(creature,(left?'left':'right')+'-arm');
  const upper=group(arm,'upper-arm');
  const upperMesh=oval(upper,'rounded-upper-arm',V(0,0,0),V(1,1,1),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:left?0xedac33:0xeeb035,roughness:.95}));
  const forearm=group(arm,'forearm');
  const hand=group(forearm,'hand');
  const sleeve=sectionMesh(forearm,'golden-forearm',1,3,40);
  const paw=sectionMesh(hand,'dark-tipped-paw',0,1,32);
  const up=V(0,1,0);
  return (q,bob,turn)=>{
    const [tx,ty,wx,wy,bx,by,btx,bty,wr,ar,near]=q;
    const sx=left?79-13*turn:177.5-4*turn;
    const sy=(left?96-8*turn:94+3*turn)+.88*bob;
    const sz=left?19-12*turn:17+20*turn;
    const ez=left?39+12*near:44+15*near;
    const wz=left?53+15.5*near:64+18*near;
    const ex=mix(bx,btx,.42),ey=mix(by,bty,.42);
    arm.position.copy(P(sx,sy,sz));
    const elbowLocal=V(ex-sx,sy-ey,ez-sz);
    const upperRadius=mix(16.8,19.3,near);
    upperMesh.position.copy(elbowLocal).multiplyScalar(.5);
    upperMesh.scale.set(upperRadius,elbowLocal.length()*.5+11,upperRadius+.5);
    upperMesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(up,elbowLocal.clone().normalize());
    forearm.position.copy(elbowLocal);
    hand.position.set(wx-ex,ey-wy,wz-ez);

    const wd=mix(14.1,16.5,near),ad=mix(16.7,19.8,near);
    const rows=[];
    function finger(u,t,shift,r){
      rows.push([u,mix(tx,wx,shift),mix(ty,wy,t),wz+mix(9.2,0,t*t),
        wr*r,wd*r]);
    }
    finger(0,0,0,0);
    finger(.035,.035,.003,.27);
    finger(.12,.12,.050,.48);
    finger(.29,.29,.21,.73);
    finger(.53,.53,.52,.90);
    finger(.73,.73,.78,.97);
    finger(1,1,1,1);
    if(!left){
      rows[4][1]+=1.9*near;
      rows[4][4]+=1.7*near;
    }
    rows.push([1.28,mix(wx,bx,.21),mix(wy,by,.28),mix(wz,ez+5,.29),
      mix(wr,ar,.38),mix(wd,ad,.42)]);
    rows.push([1.64,mix(wx,bx,.73),mix(wy,by,.64),mix(wz,ez+5,.66),
      mix(wr,ar,.84),mix(wd,ad,.86)]);
    rows.push([2,bx,by,ez+5,ar,ad]);
    for(const [u,f,r] of [[2.32,.32,.935],[2.62,.62,.77],[2.84,.84,.53],
      [2.96,.96,.277],[3,1,0]]){
      rows.push([u,mix(bx,btx,f),mix(by,bty,f),mix(ez+5,ez-2.1,f),
        ar*r,ad*r]);
    }
    const shape=profile(rows);
    updateSection(sleeve,shape,[ex,ey,ez],q,side);
    updateSection(paw,shape,[wx,wy,wz],q,side);
    pawShadows[left?0:1].set(bx-122-side*3.8,240-by-10,ar*1.16,
      Math.max(23,(bty-wy)*.48));
  };
}
const poseLeft=makeArm(true),poseRight=makeArm(false);

const feet=group(creature,'hind-paws');
const footMaterial=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd19a3d,roughness:.96});
for(const [name,x,yaw] of [['left',91,-.13],['right',159,.13]]){
  const foot=group(feet,name+'-hind-paw',P(x,262,18));
  foot.rotation.y=yaw;
  oval(foot,'paw',V(0,0,0),V(23,13,31),footMaterial);
}

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffbef,0xf2dfc5,1.76));
function light(name,color,intensity,position,aim){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  l.name=name;
  l.position.copy(position);
  l.target.position.copy(aim);
  scene.add(l,l.target);
}
light('broad-window',0xfff8e4,1.88,V(-145,379,210),V(0,124,0));
light('soft-front-fill',0xfff3e9,.76,V(169,190,226),V(0,116,0));
light('back-light',0xffedce,1.38,V(65,285,-235),V(0,133,0));

const target=new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(W,H,{
  minFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,magFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,
  depthBuffer:true,stencilBuffer:false
});
target.texture.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
const finishScene=new THREE.Scene();
const finishCamera=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1,1,1,-1,0,1);
const finishMaterial=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms:{picture:{value:target.texture}},
  depthTest:false,depthWrite:false,
  vertexShader:`
    varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){
      vUv=uv;
      gl_Position=vec4(position.xy,0.,1.);
    }`,
  fragmentShader:`
    uniform sampler2D picture;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    float order2(vec2 p){
      vec2 b=mod(floor(p),2.0);
      return 2.0*b.x+3.0*b.y-4.0*b.x*b.y;
    }
    void main(){
      vec2 h=vec2(1.42/244.0,1.42/240.0);
      vec3 c=.26*texture2D(picture,vUv).rgb;
      c+=.12*(texture2D(picture,vUv+vec2(h.x,0.)).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv-vec2(h.x,0.)).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv+vec2(0.,h.y)).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv-vec2(0.,h.y)).rgb);
      c+=.065*(texture2D(picture,vUv+h).rgb+texture2D(picture,vUv-h).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv+vec2(h.x,-h.y)).rgb
             +texture2D(picture,vUv+vec2(-h.x,h.y)).rgb);
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
      vec2 p=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
      float d=(4.0*order2(p)+order2(floor(p*.5))+.5)/16.0-.5;
      vec3 rgb=gl_FragColor.rgb;
      float white=smoothstep(.87,1.0,min(rgb.r,min(rgb.g,rgb.b)));
      rgb=floor(rgb*48.0+.5+d*.87)/48.0;
      float fleck=(1.0-step(.5,mod(p.x+p.y*3.,8.0)))
                  *(1.0-step(.5,mod(p.y,3.0)));
      rgb-=white*fleck*vec3(.002,.072,.017);
      rgb.b+=d*.013*(1.0-white);
      gl_FragColor=vec4(clamp(rgb,0.,1.),1.);
    }`
});
const screen=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2),finishMaterial);
screen.frustumCulled=false;
finishScene.add(screen);

function render(t=0){
  const ms=((Math.round(t*10000)%12000000)+12000000)%12000000/10000;
  let i=0;
  while(i<times.length-1 && ms>=times[i+1]) i++;
  const [dx,bob,roll,turn,shift]=bodyTrack(i,ms);
  head.position.copy(headPivot).add(V(dx,-bob,0));
  head.rotation.set(.0014*bob,.02*turn,roll,'ZXY');
  chest.position.copy(chestPivot).add(V(shift,-.94*bob,0));
  chest.rotation.set(.0008*bob,-.225*turn,.005*shift);
  poseLeft(leftTrack(i,ms),bob,turn);
  poseRight(rightTrack(i,ms),bob,turn);
  renderer.setRenderTarget(target);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.render(finishScene,finishCamera);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[creature],render,ready:true};
</script>
